group.name: Which Skyrim do you play on? (Skyrim Together 1.8.4)

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.7.104
plugin.description:
Skyrim Special/Anniversary Edition 1.7.104 with the Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.4 for 1.7.104 from Nexus (SKSE 2.3.x).
Installs the Skyrim Together launcher with the LipSync Together add-on (SkyrimTogetherReborn/SkyrimTogether.exe). Mod Organizer 2 users: after installing, copy it into your Skyrim Together Reborn mod's SkyrimTogetherReborn folder (back up the original first); see the README.

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.6.1170 / 1.6.1179
plugin.description:
Skyrim Special/Anniversary Edition 1.6.1170 or 1.6.1179 with the Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.4 for 1.6.1170 from Nexus (SKSE 2.2.6).
Installs the Skyrim Together launcher with the LipSync Together add-on (SkyrimTogetherReborn/SkyrimTogether.exe). Mod Organizer 2 users: after installing, copy it into your Skyrim Together Reborn mod's SkyrimTogetherReborn folder (back up the original first); see the README.

plugin.name: Require a server-relayed key (recommended)
plugin.description: Uses a random session key relayed through Skyrim Together. The relay rejects clients without a key from this server. Skyrim Together retains keys until its server restarts, so former players can still connect until then.

plugin.name: Open relay (as tested)
plugin.description: Anyone who can reach the host's voice relay port can join and hear voice chat. Use only on a trusted network.
